scope: Safari Web Inspector memory instrument observing the real iPhone WKWebView while a synthetic full runner executes; sampled inspected-page footprint, not exact whole-device peak or image-only allocation
privacy: Screenshots, request/response payloads, paths, targets, script bodies, stack traces and picker listings omitted. Do not copy raw export to repository.

categorySemantics.javascript: GCHeap totalSize plus GCOwned totalSize; on Cocoa GCHeap uses allocated block capacity, while GCOwned includes tracked extra/external memory. This is not a count of surviving JavaScript objects.
categorySemantics.versionBoundary: Current official source verified to interpret category semantics, not a byte-for-byte audit of installed iOS WebKit.

interpretation: UI 828.20 MB is 828,196,864 bytes total; it occurs about 32 seconds after resources finish, so it is not a 48 MP-only peak.
The 48 MP ladder has three unambiguously in-window samples; maximum is 707,954,688 bytes. About 0.5 s sampling can miss shorter native peaks.
Pre-run stable observed footprint is about 374 MB. The combined test does not return to this baseline during the exported recording.

High retained categories are JavaScript and Other. Images has a small nonzero observation during processing and is zero in the later baseline/peak samples; zero in that category cannot be read as no native image allocations.

The runner keeps only scalar reports/output paths globally. No global Blob/ArrayBuffer/base64 list is intentionally retained. Temporary 4 MiB buffers and Blob cache fill allocate heavily. Several page full-GC records appear after resources finish, while the category reports allocated capacity rather than only live objects; this is not by itself proof of a leak.

Screenshot/CPU/Memory/JS instruments were active, and many output files were created. Their memory effects are not isolated by this capture; neither instrumentation nor Obsidian can be assigned causal ownership without stronger evidence.

Cache 64/128/256 are sequential temporary databases. Cursor byte totals are logical persistence evidence, not resident memory. Whole recording later peak is not evidence that 256 MiB default is appropriate.
Root is checking explicit Collect garbage via Safari UI. Do not mark residual-memory concern closed before that observation is inspected.
